page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.14xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 instruction set architecture, it is provisioned with 56 dedicated vCPUs and 480 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 8.57 GB per core. The instance includes no GPU accelerators.

Network connectivity is specified at a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires network address translation or assigned elastic IPs for external network routing. In terms of local storage, none is bundled with the instance; all persistent operating system and data requirements must be handled via network-attached block storage devices.

The hardware balance makes the instance efficient for workloads constrained by RAM rather than raw compute cycles or local disk throughput. Because storage operations depend on remote volumes over the network fabric, total disk I/O shares network throughput with external traffic, which forms a key operational tradeoff compared to instances with direct-attached NVMe arrays.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.14xlarge is appropriate for large-scale in-memory database systems, key-value stores such as Redis or Memcached, transactional database backends, large-footprint enterprise resource planning software, and distributed data analytics workloads requiring substantial memory allocations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.14xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine provides 56 dedicated vCPUs along with 480 GB of system RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core allocation of approximately 8.57 GB per vCPU. It operates without hardware GPU acceleration and contains no local storage, requiring persistent storage to be provisioned through remote network-attached block devices. Networking capabilities feature a baseline network throughput of 10 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included by default. The high memory density accommodates data-heavy processing while minimizing over-provisioning of compute capacity. Given its heavy memory footprint and dedicated compute allocation, the instance is targeted at memory-intensive workloads, including large relational databases, in-memory caches, distributed processing engines, and enterprise data analytics applications.
